ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Mars

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between relationships and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between routine and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between romance and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between family and your image. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between money and friendships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your image and your career. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your career and relationships. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.
